description: Peer-reviewed open access books from DOAB, the Directory of Open Access Books: keyword search (query, 2 to 120 characters) returning title, authors/editors, publication date, abstract and the DOAB record link (with handle), plus the total number of matches. limit (1 to 50, default 20) and page walk the results in DOAB's relevance order. Use it to find free, citable academic books on a topic; it covers books only, not journal articles. A search with no match returns an empty list (charged, the search worked). Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

query.description: Keywords, e.g. climate change, digital humanities
